question: Does balanced even-degree genus-two class arithmetic retain infinity information and satisfy exact principal/pullback identities, with its root-free norm agreeing with separate Fp2 support reconstruction on the fixed finite panel?

claims.text: Does balanced even-degree genus-two class arithmetic retain infinity information and satisfy exact principal/pullback identities, with its root-free norm agreeing with separate Fp2 support reconstruction on the fixed finite panel?
No end-to-end ECDLP advantage, method clock, uniform success law, formal certificate or official scientific transition is claimed.

arms.description: Balanced triples, Cantor composition/reduction/infinity balancing, class operations and root-free elliptic norm.

parameters.shared_setup: same process and fixed input construction

arms.description: Separate quadratic-extension support reconstruction and elliptic group summation, including multiplicities and rationality refusal controls. Norm equality is not a class-equality oracle.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact finite identities and integer counts; no noisy hardware metric, population inference or comparative method clock. Both actual arms are deterministic given the same seed.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Embedded positive cases exercise the actual arithmetic path: Seven actual P-256 pullbacks must have norm [2]P, balanced pullback addition must agree with source addition, and explicit principal/infinity identities must hold. No separate positive arm is exported.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Embedded malformed-certificate/refusal controls exercise the real path: Omitted Frobenius conjugate, corrupted repeated-point multiplicity without tangent correction, and invalid infinity balance must be refused; dropping n must not make the infinity difference the identity. No statistical null-population or rate inference is planned.
